name: Steel-engraved banknote and stamp
summary: Hardened steel plates carry portraits, vignettes and geometric rosettes, printed from a transfer press. Dense fine lines and machine-turned patterns are hard to copy. The print has a tight frame of line work in green or black, with a coloured tint.

philosophy.core_thesis: Fine engraved line and machine-turned rosettes on steel are hard to copy. The print is then the proof that a note or a stamp is real.
design_principles: Engrave the portrait and the vignette with fine parallel lines, 150–200 lines an inch.
Cut the border with a rose engine, so that the guilloche lines interlace with a constant pitch.
Print the key plate in intaglio black or green, and a tint plate behind it in a lighter colour.
Print the serial numbers and the seal in a second colour, by letterpress.
Frame the picture with a closed border, with a title in engraved script.
Print from a transferred steel plate, so that many plates carry the same die.
anti_patterns: A halftone or a photographic portrait
A coarse line that a copier can reproduce

process.matrix: Hardened steel plate, transferred from a steel die by a roller (siderography)
process.image_making: Burin engraving with geometric lathe (rose engine) for guilloche borders
process.edition: Millions of notes from a plate; a steel plate lasts for a long run.

inks.strategy: Intaglio black or green for the engraving, a tint ink for the ground, and a second colour for the seal and the serial numbers.

screening.rule: Make the tone with fine parallel lines that swell, 150–200 lines an inch, and make the border with guilloche lines at a constant pitch.

registration.rule: The tint and the engraving align within 0.3 mm; an exact fit of the back and the front is a security check.

substrate.stock: Cotton-linen banknote paper with a watermark and a security thread.
substrate.finish: Crisp, with a low sheen and a firm hand.

surface.impression: Raised intaglio ink that a finger can feel on the front.
surface.sheen: Matt, with a slight rise in the black lines.
surface.texture: Very fine line work with no visible dot, and a smooth tint field behind it.

marks: serial numbers in a second colour

emotion.target_response: Sober, official trust: the viewer sees a document that carries value and was made with great care.

use_cases: bank and fintech brand marks with a heritage look
avoid_when: The image needs a loose, hand-made look.
The design needs a bright or playful colour.

modifiers.how: Replace the guilloche border with a free copper-plate vignette and drop the tint plate.
Print the engraved frame in black and fill the ground with lithographic colour.
